test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: general
question: A dealer offers a cash discount of 20% and still makes a profit of 20%. If he further sells 8 articles at a rate of 6 articles, then how much percentage above the cost price does he mark on each article?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Discount from offer (8 articles for price of 6) = 2 ÷ 8 × 100 = 25%.

Net Discount = 20% (Cash) + 25% (Quantity) − (20 × 25) ÷ 100 = 40%.

Using Ratio: MP/CP = (100 + Profit%) / (100 − Discount%) = (100 + 20) / (100 − 40) = 120 / 60 = 2 / 1.

Markup % = (2 − 1) ÷ 1 × 100 = 100%.

**∴ The correct answer is 100%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cash Discount = 20%

Profit = 20%

Article Offer = 8 articles sold at the rate of 6 (Buy 6 Get 2 Free)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/686d1e7b998337b066ebb1619490f0a85bc049067cb60bca5d679a00c1aeabf7.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Discount% = (Free Items / Total Items) × 100

MP/CP = (100 + P%) / (100 − D%)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Quantity Discount = (8 − 6) ÷ 8 × 100 = 2 ÷ 8 × 100 = 25%

⇒ Successive Discount = D₁ + D₂ − (D₁ × D₂) / 100

⇒ Net Discount = 20 + 25 − (20 × 25) / 100

⇒ Net Discount = 45 − 5 = 40%

⇒ Let CP be 100

⇒ MP / 100 = (100 + 20) / (100 − 40)

⇒ MP / 100 = 120 / 60

⇒ MP / 100 = 2

⇒ MP = 200

⇒ Markup % = [(MP − CP) / CP] × 100

⇒ Markup % = [(200 − 100) / 100] × 100 = 100%

**∴ The correct answer is 100%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

When two discounts a% and b% are given, the total effective discount is [a + b − (ab/100)]%.

MP and CP Relationship

The ratio of Marked Price (MP) to Cost Price (CP) is given by (100 + Profit%) / (100 − Discount%).

Markup Percentage

Markup% = [(Marked Price − Cost Price) / Cost Price] × 100.

Free Article Discount

Discount% in 'Buy X get Y free' schemes is calculated as [Y / (X + Y)] × 100.</p
